patterns.note: Full-bleed video sections are strategically placed as immersive visual breaks, framing key content areas and enhancing the site's dynamic feel.
Primary headings utilize an oversized, bold, uppercase sans-serif typeface for strong visual impact, contrasted with a lighter-weight sans-serif for body text and descriptive content.

A sophisticated palette of muted browns, deep blues, and soft purples is used for backgrounds and text, with white providing high contrast on dark elements and light beige for readability on lighter sections.
The header navigation bar dynamically transforms from a transparent state with white text to a solid dark background with dark text and logo as the user scrolls down the page.
Content sections are introduced with a subtle scroll-triggered animation, appearing with a gentle fade-in and slight upward translation as they enter the viewport.
Horizontal carousels are consistently employed to showcase collections of items, such as properties and events, providing an interactive way to browse content without leaving the current section.

technique_notes: The hero and mid-page sections feature full-bleed background videos, creating an immersive visual experience, with text overlays ensuring readability through contrast.
A sticky navigation bar is implemented that changes its visual style, including background color and text color, as the user scrolls past the initial hero section.
Scroll-triggered reveal animations are used to introduce new content sections, where elements fade into view and slide up slightly as they become visible in the viewport, enhancing content flow.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, bold, uppercase sans-serif headings (~4-5x body) create strong visual impact, complemented by smaller, lighter sans-serif body text for readability and detail.

standout: The site's distinctive use of full-bleed video backgrounds for both the hero and a mid-page section creates an immersive and dynamic experience. The bold, uppercase typography for main headings, combined with a muted, earthy color palette, gives the site a sophisticated yet grounded feel, avoiding a generic corporate aesthetic.
